apps.name: NekoSurf
apps.subtitle: 🍀 4chan image board viewer for iOS and Android, written in Flutter
apps.localizedDescription:
NekoSurf is a fast, privacy-friendly 4chan viewer built with Flutter for iOS and Android.

It is designed for smooth browsing with modern card-based layouts, media-first navigation, and practical quality-of-life tools for everyday use.

versions.localizedDescription:
This update makes NekoSurf feel smoother and easier to use.

- Replies are now truly threaded, so conversations are much easier to follow.
- Media viewing is now unified across threads and saved attachments for a more consistent experience.
- Saved attachments and thread UI were cleaned up, improving reliability and overall polish.
- Overall: better conversation flow, cleaner media experience, and a nicer day-to-day feel.
